CREATE TABLE BucketFixed (
  Id INT64 NOT NULL,
  Body STRING(MAX),
  UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  UpdatedSeconds INT64 NOT NULL AS (UNIX_SECONDS(UpdatedAt)) STORED,
  HourBucket INT64 NOT NULL AS (UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(UpdatedAt,HOUR))) STORED,
  BodyTokens TOKENLIST AS (TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(Body)) HIDDEN,
) PRIMARY KEY(Id)
CREATE SEARCH INDEX FixedIndexhour ON BucketFixed(BodyTokens) ORDER BY HourBucket DESC
CREATE SEARCH INDEX FixedIndexnone ON BucketFixed(BodyTokens)
CREATE SEARCH INDEX FixedIndexseconds ON BucketFixed(BodyTokens) ORDER BY UpdatedSeconds DESC

CREATE TABLE DynamicNodes (
  Id INT64 NOT NULL,

) PRIMARY KEY(Id)

CREATE TABLE JsonDocs (

) PRIMARY KEY(Id)
